title: Statutes of Frauds — comparison problems
summary: The problems compare state writing requirements and vary agreements for services, land-related transactions, and other undertakings.
notes:
Textbook problem / open questions.

For each exact fact pattern, first identify the governing state text, then its coverage, the relevant duration or interest, the sufficiency of any writing, and an applicable exception. A hotel scenario and variations across jurisdictions test whether the traditional categories have been changed. The unprovided SEL or SUPP text should not be replaced by a remembered statute.

No answer key is supplied in the assigned passage. A cited case may suggest a line of thought; its citation is not treated as the answer.
